title: Ringo Starr appears on Cilla Black’s television show | 1970
content:
Ringo Starr made a second appearance on Cilla Black’s television show Cilla on 1 October 1970.

His first appearance on the show was on 6 February 1968. The theme tune of the show was ‘Step Inside Love’ by Paul McCartney.

The show was filmed at BBC Television Theatre in London’s Shepherd’s Bush. Starr sang a duet of ‘Act Naturally’ with Black, accompanied by the 30-piece BBC Orchestra. Black also performed a version of ‘Don’t Pass Me By’ with actor Richard Harris, and ‘Back In The USSR’ with dance group The Breakaways.

The 44-minute programme also featured Stanley Holloway and John Clive, and was broadcast on BBC One on 13 February 1971 at 7.41pm. Starr was paid £750 for his appearance.
